ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, the perpendicular bisector of AC intersects AC at E and BC at D. The perimeter of $\triangle ABD$ is $13\text{cm}$, and $AE=4.5\text{cm}$. What is the perimeter of $\triangle ABC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since DE is the perpendicular bisector of AC,\\
it follows that AD = CD,\\
therefore, the perimeter of $\triangle ABD$ equals to AB + BD + AD = AB + BD + CD = AB + BC,\\
also, since AE = 4.5cm,\\
it follows that AC = 2AE = 2×4.5 = 9cm,\\
therefore, the perimeter of $\triangle ABC$ = 13 + 9 = \boxed{22}cm.
